按第6节 Configuration 开头的表格，共列出四种回零类型，各自的参数取值如下 [LCNC-HOME-c000]：

| Homing Type | HOME_SEARCH_VEL | HOME_LATCH_VEL | HOME_USE_INDEX |
|---|---|---|---|
| Immediate | 0 [LCNC-HOME-c000] | 0 [LCNC-HOME-c000] | NO [LCNC-HOME-c000] |
| Index-only | 0 [LCNC-HOME-c000] | nonzero [LCNC-HOME-c000] | YES [LCNC-HOME-c000] |
| Switch-only | nonzero [LCNC-HOME-c000] | nonzero [LCNC-HOME-c000] | NO [LCNC-HOME-c000] |
| Switch and Index | nonzero [LCNC-HOME-c000] | nonzero [LCNC-HOME-c000] | YES [LCNC-HOME-c000] |

文档同时注明，任何其他组合都可能导致错误 [LCNC-HOME-c000]。
